reason: Not refuted. This recheck keeps I-222 closed and asks only for a note, so there is no mechanism or submission to attack. The numbers reproduce from _dl/exp60_{a,b}/retention_guard_{0,1}_2.jsonl: 5,600 rows, 56 unique clips, no duplicate frames. 44b6 falls back on 33.1% of frames (6/17 clips >= 50%; 9be80b04 and e28840c6 at 100%). 6bba falls back on 3.9% (26/39 clips at 0; ab78413d 93%). Frames switch 201 times across the 56 clips. In fallback frames the blend keeps about 22% fewer candidates on 44b6 (310 -> 242) and 15% fewer on 6bba (224 -> 190). #37 (exp58) and #38 (exp58n) carry the same guard patch (retention floor 0.90, per-frame scope), so the finals choice is unaffected. Moving it to the post-deadline list is correct: the det logits are not cached, so a counterfactual needs a GPU run. Any threshold or weight change is a public-knob risk and could not get a lab gate, a dummy and an OK before R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC). Two corrections. (1) The evidence is wrong about the weight: the effective secondary detection weight is 0.80, not 0.475. The env var is set to '0.80' in exp56, exp58, exp58n and exp60, and the exp60 logs print 'detection weight=0.800'. The 0.475 in dual_seed_frame_retention_guard_report.json is a stale label hardcoded in the report writer. So the embryo-dependent switch is between an 80%-secondary blend and a primary-only detector, a larger mode change than the finding says, which makes the new fact stronger. (2) The 'no clip-level harm' result (J 0.8821 vs 0.8765; Spearman +0.16 on n=17 and +0.05 on n=39) is confounded by clip difficulty. It means 'no signal', not 'no harm'. I could not reproduce the '47% edge-weighted' figure; weighting by primary candidates gives 34.2% (44b6) and 4.0% (6bba).
fix: Curator note for I-222: 'x138, #37 and #38 switch per frame between an 80%-secondary blended detector (BIOHUB_SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT=0.80; the report JSON's 0.475 label is stale) and a primary-only detector when blended/primary candidates < 0.90. Lab fallback share: 44b6 33.1% of frames (6/17 clips >= 50%), 6bba 3.9% (26/39 clips at 0). On hidden embryos the mix depends on the embryo and cannot be measured. Clip-level data show no signal either way (confounded).' Drop or define the '47% edge-weighted' number. Post-deadline list: GPU counterfactual (guard off / floor 0.8 / weight 0.475) on the fallback-heavy clips 44b6_9be80b04, e28840c6, eb2880fc, d2f34f90, c771cb04 and 6bba_ab78413d. Use it in the shake-up analysis. No finals action and no new submission.
